relationships.subject: PY(A) peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: We found a progressive loss of NaV1.8 immunoreactivity in cultured DRG neurons when neurons were incubated with 10 µM peptide (Figs. 2C and D).

relationships.subject: PY(A) peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: Paw withdrawal latency significantly increased in the PY(A) peptide mice compared to scrambled peptide mice during each testing period after peptide injection (Fig. 4A).

relationships.subject: Magi-1
relationships.evidence_quote: We previously demonstrated that the WW domain containing protein Magi-1 is an essential scaffold for NaV1.8 channels.26

relationships.subject: Nedd4-2
relationships.evidence_quote: NaV1.8 channels are susceptible to Nedd4-2–dependent degradation.19

key_findings: A lipidated NaV1.8 WW-domain peptide PY(A) causes lysosomal degradation of NaV1.8, reduces DRG neuron firing and TTX-R current in rodent and human DRG neurons.
A single local injection attenuated CCI neuropathic pain behaviors for weeks.
